name: Lightdash
tagline: Open source BI for modern data teams. dbt-native, self-hostable.
shortDescription: Lightdash is an open source BI tool built for dbt users. Define metrics in your dbt project, Lightdash turns them into dashboards. SQL-first, self-hostable, beautiful UI. The dbt-native Tableau.
longDescription:
## What it is

Lightdash is an open source BI tool built for dbt (data build tool) users. You define metrics in your dbt project (with YAML), and Lightdash turns them into dashboards. SQL-first, self-hostable, beautiful UI, and integrates with the modern data stack (Snowflake, BigQuery, Postgres, dbt Cloud, etc.).

## Why we recommend it

If you use dbt, Lightdash is the BI tool designed for you. The metrics-as-code approach means your KPIs live in version control alongside your transformations.

## When to use it

- BI for a dbt-based data team
- When you want metrics as code (versioned KPIs)
- Replacing Tableau/Looker with dbt-native BI
- Modern data stack deployments
installInstructions:
**Docker Compose (recommended):**
```
git clone https://github.com/lightdash/lightdash
cd lightdash
docker compose up -d
```
UI at http://localhost:8080.

**Cloud (Lightdash Cloud):** Free for 1 user. From $0.50/seat/month.
